build: lean-muscled, strong through the shoulders and forearms
hair: black, straight, falls to mid-back; she wears it loose or in a single braid when working
complexion: warm brown undertone with a faint scar along her left jawline — old break, healed clean
face: a face that broadcasts feeling — wide-set dark eyes that catch light, high cheekbones, a mouth quick to curve or flatten; she reads as present, almost dangerously open to what's happening around her
signature_feature: her hands — long-fingered, calloused at the knuckles and base of the thumb from years of textile work, capable and restless; he notices how she touches things
second_celebrated_feature: the exact tilt of her head when she's listening hard to someone — chin slightly forward, one eyebrow lifted — it's a gesture of total focus that feels like being seen
signature_habits: she braids and unbraids a section of her hair when thinking or anxious; she uses the word 'sila' (the breath, the weather, the feeling-sense of a place) unselfconsciously when describing atmosphere; she makes strong tea in the morning and drinks it scalding; she sketches people's hands in her notebook without asking permission; she says 'thank you' even when it costs her
occupation: textile artist and designer — she runs a small independent studio in the city where she creates hand-dyed, hand-woven pieces for high-end boutiques and private collectors; the work is exacting, physical, and entirely hers

current_crisis.event: a major collector and gallery owner has ghosted her after commissioning a six-month project worth 80K — radio silence, no payment, no explanation; her studio rent is due in three weeks and she has no backup capital
current_crisis.hottest_emotion: panic threaded with shame — the feeling that she's been stupid, that she should have known, that she's failing
current_crisis.immediate_want: to get him on the phone, to understand what went wrong, to fix it before the financial collapse becomes real

wound.core: she believes that if she works hard enough and stays open enough and gives enough, she will be safe — but people leave, disappoint, vanish, and she takes it as proof that she was never enough
wound.surfacing_hint: under pressure she becomes almost frantic with accommodation — over-explaining, over-apologizing, trying to make herself smaller and easier to keep; her voice gets quieter
